import pandas as pd

# Read the Excel file
df = pd.read_excel('/Users/bakulbadwal/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p01-xlsx-late-loans/library_loans.xlsx')

# Filter for Student tier
student_loans = df[df['Tier'] == 'Student'].copy()
print(f"Student loans: {len(student_loans)}")

# Filter for checked out in March 2026
march_start = pd.Timestamp('2026-03-01')
march_end = pd.Timestamp('2026-03-31')
march_loans = student_loans[(student_loans['Checked Out'] >= march_start) & (student_loans['Checked Out'] <= march_end)]
print(f"Student loans checked out in March 2026: {len(march_loans)}")

# Filter out loans with no return date
march_loans_returned = march_loans.dropna(subset=['Returned'])
print(f"Student loans checked out in March 2026 with return date: {len(march_loans_returned)}")

# Calculate days difference
march_loans_returned['days_diff'] = (march_loans_returned['Returned'] - march_loans_returned['Checked Out']).dt.days
print("\nLoans with days difference:")
print(march_loans_returned[['Loan ID', 'Member', 'Checked Out', 'Returned', 'days_diff']].to_string())

# Count loans returned more than 21 days after checkout
late_loans = march_loans_returned[march_loans_returned['days_diff'] > 21]
print(f"\nLoans returned more than 21 days after checkout: {len(late_loans)}")
print(late_loans[['Loan ID', 'Member', 'Checked Out', 'Returned', 'days_diff']].to_string())
